# InOne Copilot instructions

Before starting any task, read `/development/AI-AGENT-MANDATE.md` completely and follow its required reading order. Treat it as mandatory project policy.

Do not implement from chat context alone. Check the current GitHub branch/SHA, continuity docs, approved decisions, previous report and five-item rolling checklist. All owner-provided files must be inspected and preserved in the correct GitHub branch. Commit and push all deliverables; verify remote refs and hashes. Write a timestamped report under `development/reports/` after every completed stage and substantial session, and update the session log. Reports must contain previous/next five-task checklists and cumulative readiness estimates.

Never invent product decisions, silently change scope, merge before all checks are green on the exact SHA, or start servers/deployments/expose databases without explicit owner permission. Chat messages do not replace repository reports. If blocked or uncertain, document it and ask the owner.
